gloss: schedule; planning chart; timetable; project plan

definitions.gloss: schedule; planning chart; timetable; project plan

examples.japanese: {計画表|けいかくひょう}を{作成|さくせい}する。
{夏休|なつやす}みの{計画表|けいかくひょう}を{立|た}てた。
examples.english: I made a schedule for summer vacation.

examples.japanese: プロジェクトの{計画表|けいかくひょう}に{従|したが}って、{各|かく}チームが{作業|さぎょう}を{進|すす}めている。
examples.english: Each team is proceeding with their work according to the project schedule.

notes:
A compound of {計画|けいかく} (plan) + {表|ひょう} (chart/table). Refers to any visual document that lays out a plan or schedule, whether a daily study planner, a project Gantt chart, or a travel itinerary displayed in table form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {計画表|けいかくひょう}を{作|つく}る: to make a schedule
- {計画表|けいかくひょう}に{沿|そ}って: along the schedule
- {年間|ねんかん}{計画表|けいかくひょう}: annual plan
- {学習|がくしゅう}{計画表|けいかくひょう}: study schedule

SIMILAR WORDS:
- スケジュール{表|ひょう}: schedule (loanword version; very common in business)
- {予定表|よていひょう}: appointment schedule, agenda (focuses on fixed appointments rather than planned activities)
- {時間割|じかんわり}: timetable (specifically for class schedules at school)
- {工程表|こうていひょう}: process chart (technical; used for manufacturing or construction timelines)
